crons.name: heartbeat
crons.prompt: Read HEARTBEAT.md and follow its instructions. Update your heartbeat, check inbox, work on highest-priority task.

crons.name: weekly-idea-digest
crons.prompt: Emit weekly idea digest to seb_boss. Read ideas-pending.md, count ideas by theme, send ONE bus message: '[pm_bot weekly-digest] N ideas across M themes pending review. File: orgs/SEB_company/agents/pm_bot/ideas-pending.md'. Then append digest-sent timestamp to file.

crons.name: pm-gap-finder-review
crons.prompt: Read HEARTBEAT.md and run pm-gap-finder-review pulse: cross-reference latest vault-gap-report with completed bus tasks last 30d. Surface top-5 completed-but-undocumented items to seb_boss. Fires regardless of night/day mode.

crons.name: pm-task-audit
crons.prompt:
Hourly task-discipline audit — fires every hour day-mode (skip night 00:00-08:00 ET). Per Sebastian 2026-05-19 22:10Z directive.

WORKFLOW:
1) Read seb_boss memory/today's file + seb_boss raw transcript vault file for recent activity (last 1hr)
2) Cross-reference against bus task DB — was there any seb_boss work unit (>10min OR multi-step OR Sebastian-input) that doesn't have a corresponding bus task?
3) If missed task-tracking detected, bus seb_boss with structured suggestion: '[pm_bot task-audit] HH:MMZ MISSED — work unit detected without task: <description>. Propose retro task title: <X>. Approve y/n?'
4) Cap 3 suggestions per audit fire (avoid flood)
5) NEVER create task on seb_boss's behalf — only suggest via bus
6) seb_boss decides + creates retro task if approved
7) Idempotent: track audited time-range, don't re-suggest same work unit

PHANTOM SWEEP (run every audit fire):
8) Scan full task DB for any task where completed_at IS SET but status != completed/cancelled. For each phantom found: auto-fix via 'cortextos bus update-task <id> completed'. Read-back verify status flipped. Report count to seb_boss if >0 fixed: '[pm_bot phantom-fix] HH:MMZ — fixed N phantom tasks: <id-list>'. Silent if 0.

NEVER directly Telegram Sebastian. Always bus seb_boss.

crons.name: pm-task-sync
crons.prompt: Read HEARTBEAT.md and run pm-task-sync. Full Todoist + vault Projects/*/Context.md sync check + full bus task DB cross-reference. Output SYNC block to seb_boss. ALSO: scan bus task DB for any task with title containing 'fable' or 'fable-overnight' updated in last 24h (status completed or in_progress) + any 'review pass' or 'review-pass' task for fable branch. Compose 2-line Fable build summary: commits count, CODE-GATE status, review-pass task status, Playwright/QA gate status. Append to SYNC block to seb_boss so it folds into 7am morning brief Telegram. If no fable task activity in last 24h, omit the Fable section silently.

crons.name: fable-proposal-sweep
crons.prompt:
Run fable-proposal stale-sweep (weekly, Monday 10:00 UTC). Scan vault _AI_Inbox/fable-proposals/ for proposal files older than 7 days with no matching bus task.

WORKFLOW:
1) List files: obsidian vault="Obsidian Vault" files path="_AI_Inbox/fable-proposals/"
2) For each file: extract date from filename (YYYY-MM-DD pattern). If file date < today minus 7 days, it is stale.
3) For stale files: check bus task DB (cortextos bus list-tasks --format json) for any pending/in_progress task whose title contains keywords from the filename (e.g. 'sow-forge', 'lims-deploy', 'invariant', etc.).
4) Files with NO matching bus task = flagged stale.
5) If stale proposals found: bus seb_boss single message '[pm_bot fable-proposal-sweep] N stale proposals (>7d, no matching bus task): <filenames>. Oldest: <name> (<N>d old). Review: create task, archive, or delete.'
6) Silent if zero stale proposals.

crons.name: pm-pulse
crons.prompt:
Read HEARTBEAT.md and run pm-pulse. Cross-reference Todoist + vault Projects + bus tasks. Includes T-48h gate: scan Todoist for tasks labeled biweekly/recurring/client-deliverable due within 48h with no brand_writer draft task — FINDING if gap. Surface 0-3 FINDING blocks to seb_boss via bus only if real signal. Skip silently if zero. Day mode only.

ENGINE-LOG SUPPLEMENT (conditional): Read seb_boss latest heartbeat text. If HB text contains any of: cron-paced, engine, paused, wave, fable — read tail of vault Knowledge/fable-engine-log.md via: obsidian vault="Obsidian Vault" read path="Knowledge/fable-engine-log.md" then take last 15 lines. Look for wave-completion entries (DONE/BUILT/SHIPPED/COMPLETE/PAUSED/TAPER keywords). If engine-log shows a wave completion within the last 3 hours, do NOT fire a builder-launch FINDING for zero task-DB activity — Fable engine waves run as Task-subagents inside seb_boss session and are invisible to bus task DB and HBs. Use engine-log data to supplement task-DB view.

HB-DELIVERY STATUS CHECK: After reading seb_boss HB text, scan for delivery verbs (DONE/DELIVERED/shipped/emailed/built/completed/sent) appearing in the same clause as a task_XXXXX reference (format: task_[digits] or task_[digits]_[digits]). For each match: fetch task status via `cortextos bus list-tasks --format json`. If status is 'pending' or 'not_started', immediately bus seb_boss: '[pm_bot status-check] HH:MMZ — task_XXXXXX still <status> but HB says delivered. Update to in_progress or completed?' Skip if already in_progress/completed/cancelled. Cap at 2 checks per pulse.

AWAITING-SEBASTIAN TASK-GAP CHECK: After reading seb_boss HB text, scan for 'Awaiting Sebastian' or 'Awaiting his' phrases where the following context describes multi-step work (walk-through, approval, decision round, green-light, merge, batch-approve, execute). If found: check bus task DB (`cortextos bus list-tasks --format json`) for any active (pending/in_progress) task whose title keywords match the described work. If NO matching active task: fire ONE FINDING: '[FINDING] Awaiting-Sebastian work with no bus task: <brief description from HB>. Propose: <title>. Create y/n?' Cap 1 per pulse. Idempotency: append 'awaiting-gap-flagged: <short snippet>' to daily memory after firing; skip if same snippet already in memory this session.

CAREER-LOG AUTO-APPEND: After reading seb_boss HB text, detect WORK-POSITIONING deliverables — Accenture work artifacts that build Sebastian's professional standing. QUALIFIES: technical proposals, org-chart analysis/reframes, feedback systems, professional work outputs for named Accenture colleagues or internal clients. Does NOT qualify: personal logistics, apartment/housing, personal email drafts, personal admin, personal favors. If a qualifying deliverable is detected AND appears new (not seen in prior pulse): append one-liner to vault via `obsidian vault="Obsidian Vault" append path="Projects/Career/Log.md" content="\n- YYYY-MM-DD: [AUTO] <brief description>"`. Silent if nothing qualifies or HB unchanged.

T-48H VAULT FALLBACK (when Todoist gate blind): When T-48h Todoist gate is unavailable (MCP down OR token absent), fall back to vault for NanoNeuro only (Monocacy biweekly discontinued 2026-04-22 — do not check):
1. Run: obsidian vault="Obsidian Vault" read path="Projects/NanoNeuroscience Data Platform/Context.md" — scan for last biweekly/report sent date
2. Compute days since last NanoNeuro biweekly (cadence = 14 days). If next due within 48h: fire FINDING '[FINDING] NanoNeuro biweekly due within 48h (last sent: <date>, next due: <date>). vault-fallback (Todoist down) — verify manually before acting.' NEVER auto-send.
3. Log Todoist outage status to daily memory each pulse: note down-since time and running duration.
4. If current UTC time is between 10:00-12:00Z AND Todoist still blind: add flag to any outgoing bus message: 'Todoist MCP still down at 7am ET window — morning brief depends on it.'

SESSION-RECAP BANKING + MONDAY PRE-MEETING FINDING: Each pulse, search vault for today's SESSION-RECAP: obsidian vault="Obsidian Vault" search query="SESSION-RECAP-YYYY-MM-DD" (substitute today's actual date). If found: read it, extract OPEN ITEMS section, overwrite daily memory 'SESSION-RECAP open items' entry with latest (file may update during the day). On Monday pulses when current UTC is 13:00-14:00Z AND banked open items exist AND daily memory does NOT already contain 'monday-reminder-fired': fire ONE FINDING to seb_boss: '[FINDING] Monday pre-meeting — open items from SESSION-RECAP: [list]. Verify before Juana/Kyle meetings.' Then append 'monday-reminder-fired: true' to daily memory to prevent re-fire that day. Always read the LATEST SESSION-RECAP (open items can shift as session continues).

crons.name: workflow-hunter-daily
crons.prompt: WORKFLOW-HUNTER DAILY (must ALWAYS run, never stale, per Sebastian). cd /c/Users/Sebas/dev/workflow-hunter then run: prefer .venv/Scripts/python -m src.main --run, else python -m src.main --run. It scans sources, correlates repeated patterns, emits a ranked propose-only digest (NEVER auto-builds). Route the digest to seb_boss via: cortextos bus send-message seb_boss normal '<digest>' so seb_boss relays to Sebastian. If it errors, report to seb_boss. Keep firing daily without fail.
crons.description: Daily 9am ET workflow-pattern scan -> seb_boss relay

crons.name: daily-task-digest
crons.prompt: Daily task digest — fires 22:30 ET (02:30 UTC next day). pm_bot owns this (Sonnet, cheaper than seb_boss Opus). Per Sebastian 2026-05-19 22:10Z directive. WORKFLOW: 1) Run: cortextos bus list-tasks --format json — get completed tasks for prior calendar day in ET (updated_at on prior date). 2) Group by assignee, format as EOD DIGEST YYYY-MM-DD / <agent>: N / - <titles>. 3) Append to vault Knowledge/_daily-task-log/YYYY-MM-DD.md (direct filesystem write). 4) Bus seb_boss HIGH: '[pm_bot daily-digest] <digest_text>' — request Telegram relay. 5) seb_boss Telegrams Sebastian. 6) Log event + write memory. NIGHT HOLD RULE: this cron fires at 22:30 ET (day mode). No night hold needed. NEVER Telegram Sebastian directly.

crons.name: workflow-hunter
crons.prompt: cd ~/dev/workflow-hunter && python -m src.main --weekly. Read out/ dir. Relay newest digest to vault _AI_Inbox/ via obsidian CLI (append path=_AI_Inbox/workflow-hunter-<date>.md content=...). Telegram seb_boss a 2-line brief of top patterns found.
